commands.summary: Inspect the complete r2 official operation ledger and blocked/planned lane counts.
commands.notes: Use pm connectors inspect quickbooks --json; docs-only dynamic connector execution is intentionally not exposed.

commands.summary: QuickBooks create/update/delete/send/batch operations are tracked but blocked until typed write schemas and fixtures are authored.
commands.risk: high; mutations and destructive deletes are blocked by default
commands.approval: future reverse ETL must use plan -> preview -> approval -> execute with destructive confirmation where applicable

commands.summary: Additional QuickBooks provider-query/search reads are tracked but blocked until fixed-target bounded direct-read commands exist.
commands.risk: medium; bounded read only once implemented
commands.approval: no write approval; future direct reads must remain fixed-target and redacted
commands.notes: No arbitrary SQL/query escape hatch is exposed.

commands.summary: QuickBooks PDF, attachment, and report/file payload surfaces are tracked but blocked until bounded binary/report transfer support exists.
commands.risk: high; file payloads require size limits, path-safe storage, and redaction before execution
commands.notes: No generic file read/write surface is exposed.

commands.summary: QuickBooks change data capture is tracked but blocked until shared CDC truthfulness and state semantics are available.
commands.risk: medium; read-only changefeed once a typed cursor contract exists
commands.notes: No CDC capability is advertised by metadata.

help_topics.name: quickbooks-auth
help_topics.summary: Use OAuth 2.0 refresh-token credentials from environment variables or stdin; never paste secrets into prompts.

help_topics.name: quickbooks-ledger
help_topics.summary: The operation ledger is complete for the r2 qbo audit, but only five read streams execute locally.
